scope: Source-scene-locked Wuji Hand replacement and synchronized short flower-arranging comparison
summary: The retained v4 Wuji comparison keeps the source camera and scene unchanged outside a declared hand-and-arm mask, while the flower card now compares the exact previously accepted 89-frame robot replacement with its synchronized human source. The rendering infrastructure is WORKING, but both outputs remain PARTIAL physical evidence.
evidence: Wuji v4 decodes to 621 frames at 30 FPS and has SHA-256 e923a904efd430ea3fcae054b260ea2ee46eb20310632092d9fee270d871cb68.

The compositor has zero maximum RGB difference outside the declared camera-pixel mask before H.264 encoding; the lossless mask SHA-256 is 686d839a24be1e31ed3e4ce3918e3210086f406e237a6c7db8109a9a74dfebfe.

The post-decode exterior audit with a 6-pixel guard has mean MAE 0.494549, p95 MAE 0.555237, and maximum channel difference 146, attributable to lossy-codec edge propagation rather than pre-encode scene edits.

The render scale is fixed at 0.8198790678 with zero maximum frame step; the complete 621x20 q/qdot trajectory has 621 direct detections, no held observations, and zero joint-position or velocity-limit violations.
The Wuji scene-locked render takes 115.5583 seconds at 5.3739 FPS; the complete composite, encode, and audit path takes 148.1936 seconds at 4.1905 effective FPS.

Wuji v1 was rejected for an incorrect forearm axis and visible source arm; v2 was rejected because the skin component merged with the gray board and edited a large background region; v3 was rejected for residual source-skin triangles.

The synchronized flower comparison is 89 frames at 24 FPS with SHA-256 ebc9e9f6096b658d545ebd2fe7cd113ff3dc2ae6df0a7c68ed23636af7cfce92; its right panel is the immutable accepted replacement SHA-256 2afd1238a976b3b87b10ebbcbccb83ac3d5e3ca630af184738bb8bb2df00f255 that passed 56/56 frozen gates.
lessons: Same-scene replacement must be accepted on pixels outside a declared edit mask, not on visual similarity alone.
A fixed screen-space render scale prevents geometry-size breathing that joint smoothing cannot address.
Public comparison videos should place the source and candidate on a common frame clock and preserve the exact accepted candidate by hash.
limitations: The Wuji hand is an official-model simulation with a procedural forearm, not footage or telemetry from physical Wuji hardware.
Monocular observations do not prove metric depth, contact force, tactile closure, or physical execution.
The flower comparison covers only the previously accepted 3.708-second window, not the complete 27.5-second video.
The flower contact gates are projected 2-D relations and do not establish 3-D force closure.
next_actions: Deploy the comparison bundle, then verify production media hashes, HTMLMediaElement playback, page order, and QR behavior independently.
Keep the long flower demo hidden until a full-length challenger passes the unchanged adversarial gates.
